verdict.rationale: Benchmark's API page says campaign results can be pulled into BI tools and dashboards, and API keys carry a 'reports' permission scope, so the API documents campaign metrics extraction. Nothing shows flow or automation performance metrics being exposed, and no endpoint reference, metric fields or OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: flow/automation performance metrics via API, documented report endpoints and metric fields, warehouse-oriented bulk export details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull campaign and flow performance metrics through the API into my own warehouse or dashboards

citations.quote: Pull campaign results into your BI tool, your weekly digest, or whatever dashboard you actually look at.
Per-resource permissions: No Access, Read, or Read & Write (contacts, campaigns, reports, domains)
